_doc: Frozen power standard for DAX W1. See dax/memo/PI_DECISION_D3_2026-08-18.md and prospective PI decision commit 4577fecab7b4e142cb28d78d4aec0800637c7b05. This file is the ONLY source of the pass bar. Nothing may recompute it from the analysis sample; freeze_power_standard.py fills it once from the frozen pre-event CPS extract and refuses to overwrite without --force.

frozen_window.rationale: Ends the month before the first eligible event (GPT4_LAUNCH, 2023-03), so the constant cannot contain any post-treatment information.

benchmark.quantity: relative decline in EMPLOYMENT (headcount), not payroll
benchmark.measured_in: ADP administrative payroll data — 'payroll' names the DATA SOURCE, not the outcome variable. This distinction is what M2 flagged.
benchmark.population: workers ages 22-25 in the most AI-exposed occupations
benchmark.citation: Brynjolfsson, E., B. Chandar, and R. Chen. 2025. "Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence." Working paper.
locators: docs/DAX_ERE_Proposal_v3.md:12 (proposal states 13 percent relative employment decline)
Brynjolfsson, Chandar, Chen, August 26 2025 version, abstract, printed p.1 (13 percent relative employment decline)
same August 26 2025 version, Section 5 Conclusion, printed p.26, fourth bullet (13%)

benchmark.version_note: Prospective PI decision commit 4577fecab7b4e142cb28d78d4aec0800637c7b05 selected 0.13 from the authenticated August 26 2025 authored version as the primary external empirical effect-size calibration scale. It is not the DAX treatment coefficient. The authenticated November 13 2025 value 0.16 and the historical PI design target 0.19 are prespecified sensitivities. The 0.19 sensitivity is normative and must not be represented as an externally sourced literature estimate unless a valid primary locator is later recovered.
benchmark.version_chosen: August 26 2025 authored version, 0.13 relative employment decline
benchmark.version_supersedes: Temporary 0.19 PI target adopted 2026-08-18 with unresolved external provenance
benchmark.locator_caveat: VERIFIED applies to the primary 0.13 locator only. The 0.16 sensitivity has its separate authenticated November 13 2025 locator. The 0.19 sensitivity remains a historical normative PI design target with unresolved external empirical provenance.
benchmark.interpretation: external empirical effect-size calibration scale, not an estimate of the DAX treatment coefficient
benchmark.comparability_caveat: DAX differs from the external paper in exposure definition, sample, period, treatment unit, and estimand.

prespecified_sensitivities.role: historical DAX PI normative design-target sensitivity

forbidden: recomputing after the event set, mapping, dose definition, window rule or sample changes
